style: Modern clean 'faceless YouTube' stickman cartoon. The SAME recurring character in every image: a simple WHITE stick-figure with thin black stick arms and legs, a round white head with BIG expressive cartoon eyes and an expressive mouth, wearing a bright RED hoodie. Bold clean black outlines, smooth flat vector shading, vibrant and energetic, small motion lines for dynamism, clean light near-white background. Vertical 9:16, subject centered.
no_text_rule: IMPORTANT: purely visual illustration. Do NOT write any text, words, letters, numbers, captions or labels anywhere. Buttons and screens are blank. Communicate only by drawing.

scenes.prompt: The red-hoodie stickman holds up a smartphone to film itself but shyly covers its own face with its other hand; a small glowing red record dot above the phone; motion lines.
The red-hoodie stickman stands nervously with a worried face and a sweat drop, its head surrounded by glowing lightbulbs and swirling idea doodles, frozen in front of a big blank rounded push-button.
On the left the red-hoodie stickman; a big bold curved arrow points right to a smartphone; inside the phone screen a friendly identical stickman avatar twin with little speech lines from its mouth.

The red-hoodie stickman points up at a rounded speech bubble that contains ONLY the single handwritten lowercase word "avatar"; below the bubble a big bold arrow pointing straight down. The ONLY text is the word 'avatar' in the bubble.
